def get_colors(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    colors = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        b = n['boundary']
        r_min = min(p[0] for p in b)

print("After: ", after_list)

# Find differences

for i, pos in enumerate(positions):
    if before_colors.get(pos) != after_colors.get(pos):
        diffs.append((i, pos, before_colors.get(pos), after_colors.get(pos)))
print(f"\nChanged positions: {diffs}")
